text.tspan: Transformer-XL relative attention | Operators & tensor flow
Relative AC+shift(BD) / memory4,current3 / heads2x8 / post-norm / eval / read bottom to top
Current T3; memoryM4; K7; two heads width8; external relative encodings and separate biases.
Content score AC and shifted relative score BD are separate source branches.
Caller memory is consumed; output contains current positions only; no memory update is drawn.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.

g.aria-label: 节点 txl.w Current sequence w
节点 txl.memory Caller memory / fixed branch
节点 txl.position Supplied relative encoding r
节点 txl.biases Caller content / relative biases
节点 txl.external_mask Caller 3D attention mask
节点 txl.output Return normalized current output
节点 txl.cat Concat [memory, current w] / time
节点 txl.rlinear Position Linear16 -> 16
节点 txl.rview View relative heads / no batch
节点 txl.qkv Joint QKV Linear16 -> 48
节点 txl.split Chunk Q_all,K,V / last axis
节点 txl.q Keep last3 Q + view heads
节点 txl.k View memory + current K heads
节点 txl.v View memory + current V heads
节点 txl.rw Q + external content bias
节点 txl.rr Q + external relative bias
节点 txl.ac Content score AC / einsum
节点 txl.bd Relative score BD / einsum
节点 txl.zero Zeros from BD shape/device/dtype
节点 txl.pad Prepend zero column / dim1
节点 txl.shift_view View [K+1,T,B,heads]
节点 txl.shift_slice Drop first row + view_as(BD)
节点 txl.score AC + shifted BD
节点 txl.scale Multiply by 1 / sqrt(d_head8)
节点 txl.mask 3D mask / True -> -inf
节点 txl.softmax Softmax on key-time axis1
节点 txl.dropatt Attention Dropout .1 / eval
节点 txl.aggregate einsum(prob, memory+current V)
节点 txl.merge Contiguous + merge heads
节点 txl.olinear Output Linear16 -> 16
节点 txl.odrop Output Dropout .1 / eval
节点 txl.residual Original current w + attention out
节点 txl.norm Post LayerNorm16 / library
